calibration_seed.description: Seed for stratified calibration/stacking mask (e.g. align with MC validation seed).
calibration_seed.title: Calibration Seed

calibration_train_fraction.description: Stratified per-class fraction for fitting isotonic calibrators and fitted chromosome weights; None or omitted uses the full labeled set.
calibration_train_fraction.title: Calibration Train Fraction

centroid1_dir.description: Path to centroid1 output directory (H5 files). Sample list is read from each file's 'samples_used' metadata (union across files). Use with centroid2_dir.
centroid1_dir.title: Centroid1 Dir

centroid1_sample_paths.description: Explicit list of sample directories for centroid1 (class 0). Overrides centroid1_dir if set. Use with centroid2_sample_paths.
centroid1_sample_paths.title: Centroid1 Sample Paths

centroid2_dir.description: Path to centroid2 output directory (H5 files). Sample list is read from each file's 'samples_used' metadata (union across files). Use with centroid1_dir.
centroid2_dir.title: Centroid2 Dir

centroid2_sample_paths.description: Explicit list of sample directories for centroid2 (class 1). Overrides centroid2_dir if set. Use with centroid1_sample_paths.
centroid2_sample_paths.title: Centroid2 Sample Paths

centroid_dirs.description: List of centroid directories for N-class (one per class). When len > 2, use with multiclass_class_names and a DMP CSV to build a multiclass model.
centroid_dirs.title: Centroid Dirs

centroid_path_remap.description: Prefix replacement for paths from centroid metadata: {"old_prefix": "new_prefix", ...}. Longest matching key is replaced so relative paths are preserved. Use when samples live under a different base (e.g. NAS). Overrides centroid_sample_root.
centroid_path_remap.title: Centroid Path Remap

centroid_sample_root.description: When reading samples_used from centroid H5 metadata, remap each path to <centroid_sample_root>/<basename(path)>. Use when data moved to NAS so metadata still has old paths. Ignored if centroid_path_remap is set.
centroid_sample_root.title: Centroid Sample Root

chromosome_matrix_path.description: Optional output CSV file for chromosome probability matrix (samples × chromosomes)
chromosome_matrix_path.title: Chromosome Matrix Path

chromosome_weights.description: Predefined chromosome weights (bypasses trimmed-mean calculation). Dict format: {'1': 0.5, '2': 0.3, ...}
chromosome_weights.title: Chromosome Weights

class_priors.description: Optional binary class priors [p(class0), p(class1)] for ECDF posterior.
class_priors.title: Class Priors

dependence_block_shrinkage.description: Optional shrinkage for dependence-aware block aggregation.
dependence_block_shrinkage.title: Dependence Block Shrinkage

dependence_block_size.description: Optional dependence-aware aggregation block size (1 = independent-loci).
dependence_block_size.title: Dependence Block Size

enable_platt_calibration.description: Enable Platt scaling calibration on validation data
enable_platt_calibration.title: Enable Platt Calibration

expected_classes.description: Optional list of expected class index per sample (for validation report). Set when samples are built from centroid_dirs.
expected_classes.title: Expected Classes

input_path.description: Path to input .h5 file or directory containing .h5 files (alternative to samples list)
input_path.title: Input Path

log_level.description: Logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)
log_level.title: Log Level

min_observed_dmp_fraction.description: Minimum fraction of classifier DMP positions that must be observed in a sample; if coverage is below this after masking missing values, the sample is abstained (uniform class probabilities, prediction -1, predicted_class=abstain in CSV). 0 disables abstention.
min_observed_dmp_fraction.title: Min Observed Dmp Fraction

model_dir.description: Path to directory containing classifier-{chrom}.pkl files (alternative to model_path)
model_dir.title: Model Dir

model_path.description: Path to trained classifier model (.pkl file) or directory containing classifier-{chrom}.pkl files
model_path.title: Model Path

multiclass_class_names.description: Class names for multiclass (same order as centroid_dirs). Used when centroid_dirs has more than 2 entries.
multiclass_class_names.title: Multiclass Class Names

no_filter.description: Process all .h5 files without chromosome/context filtering
no_filter.title: No Filter

output_path.description: Optional output CSV file for classification results
output_path.title: Output Path

ovr_binary_model_paths.description: K>=2 MethylDetector PKL paths (OvR order). Assembles ecdf_one_vs_rest at runtime; omit model_dir when set.
ovr_binary_model_paths.title: Ovr Binary Model Paths

ovr_bipartite_aggregate.description: True when ovr_detection_dirs lists M×N bipartite pairwises (multi-control × multi-disease).
ovr_bipartite_aggregate.title: Ovr Bipartite Aggregate

ovr_class_names.description: Optional override for OvR class names; defaults to multiclass_class_names when multiclass.
ovr_class_names.title: Ovr Class Names

ovr_detection_dirs.description: K>=2 MethylDetector output dirs (OvR order). One pickle per dir = single-chrom head; multiple classifier-*.pkl = multi-chrom expert per class. Alternative to ovr_binary_model_paths.
ovr_detection_dirs.title: Ovr Detection Dirs

ovr_fuse_mode.description: Optional OvR fusion mode override: flat | pairwise_max_contrast.
ovr_fuse_mode.title: Ovr Fuse Mode

ovr_n_control_classes.description: M for ovr_bipartite_aggregate; N = len(ovr_class_names) - M.
ovr_n_control_classes.title: Ovr N Control Classes

ovr_pairwise_aggregate_control.description: True when ovr_detection_dirs lists K-1 pairwise folders and first OvR class is control (geometric-mean aggregate head).
ovr_pairwise_aggregate_control.title: Ovr Pairwise Aggregate Control

panel.description: OvR pairwise max-contrast only: panel spec (primary_family, families, optional indeterminate_delta). Adds panel columns and panel_report.json when classifying with samples_list / centroid validation.
panel.title: Panel

project_name.description: Project name for saving classifier as <project_name>-classifier.pkl and sample list. Used when save_classifier_path or samples_list_export_path are not set.
project_name.title: Project Name

residualize_coef_dir.description: Optional residualize_fit coefficient directory. When unset, sample features are raw betas (shipped-pack path).
residualize_coef_dir.title: Residualize Coef Dir

samples.description: List of sample directory paths. Each directory should contain {chrom}-CG.h5, {chrom}-CHG.h5, {chrom}-CHH.h5 files. Contexts will be merged. (alternative to input_path)
samples.title: Samples

samples_list_export_path.description: Path to export the list of sample folders (.txt or .csv). If null and project_name set, uses <output_dir>/<project_name>-samples.txt.
samples_list_export_path.title: Samples List Export Path

save_classifier_path.description: Path to save the final classifier .pkl after classification. If null and project_name set, uses <output_dir>/<project_name>-classifier.pkl.
save_classifier_path.title: Save Classifier Path

trimmed_percentile_high.description: Upper percentile for trimmed mean effect_size calculation - removes top X% (default: 0.01 = remove top 1%). High effect_size DMPs are important for classification, so only remove outliers.
trimmed_percentile_high.title: Trimmed Percentile High

trimmed_percentile_low.description: Lower percentile for trimmed mean effect_size calculation - removes bottom X% (default: 0.10 = remove bottom 10%)
trimmed_percentile_low.title: Trimmed Percentile Low

use_elasticnet_stacking.description: Enable ElasticNet chromosome stacking when fitting weights from labeled data.
use_elasticnet_stacking.title: Use Elasticnet Stacking

use_isotonic_calibration.description: Enable isotonic calibration when labels are available (centroid validation / training export).
use_isotonic_calibration.title: Use Isotonic Calibration

weight_fit_alpha.description: Regularization strength for fitted weights (inverse of C for logistic).
weight_fit_alpha.title: Weight Fit Alpha

weight_method.description: How to obtain chromosome weights: 'config', 'effect_size', or 'linear_fitted'. If None, inferred from chromosome_weights.
weight_method.title: Weight Method
